hero.title: Frequently Asked Questions About AfriNuts Export
hero.subtitle: Organic Cashews, Farm OS Technology, and Ethical Investment
hero.description: Get clear answers about our tech-enabled cashew farm in Odienné, Ivory Coast. Learn about Farm OS traceability, organic practices, processing plans, community impact, and how to partner with us.

stillQuestions.title: Didn't find your answer
stillQuestions.content: Ask us anything about our farm, products, or investment opportunities.

questions.question: What is Farm OS?
questions.answer: Farm OS is our custom-built farm management platform — an offline-first Android application with cloud synchronization. It tracks every block, every tree, every expense, and every harvest. Buyers get traceability data. Investors get real-time dashboards. Partners can license it. It is the technology backbone of everything we do.

questions.question: What is AfriNuts Export?
questions.answer: AfriNuts Export is a tech-enabled cashew farm and future processing company based in Odienné, Ivory Coast. We grow organic cashews on our 35-hectare farm, manage operations through our custom-built Farm OS platform, and reinvest 10% of profits into community development like schools, water wells, and mosques.

questions.question: Where is your farm located?
questions.answer: Our 35-hectare cashew farm is in Odienné, northwestern Ivory Coast. Every block is GPS-mapped in our Farm OS — we can tell you exactly which row and column your cashews came from.

questions.question: What products do you offer?
questions.answer: We currently grow raw cashew nuts, which will be harvested and sold as unprocessed nuts during the early phases. As the farm matures, we will expand into value-added products through our upcoming processing facility.

questions.question: How do you grow your cashews?
questions.answer: We plant 100 trees per hectare across 35 individually tracked blocks. Our Farm OS logs planting dates, survival rates, and maintenance activities per block — not per farm. We also maintain a nursery reserve of 500 seedlings for replacement.

questions.question: When is your harvest season?
questions.answer: Our first trees were planted in 2026. First small harvest expected 2029, with peak production by 2031. Every harvest is logged in Farm OS by block, date, and volume — buyers receive this data with their shipment.

questions.question: Are your cashews organic?
questions.answer: While not yet certified organic, we use sustainable and chemical-minimal farming methods that align with agroecological practices. We plan to pursue organic certification as part of our ESG goals.

questions.question: What sustainability practices do you follow?
questions.answer: We use rainfed agriculture to conserve water and avoid the need for irrigation in Phase 1. We also employ firebreaks to prevent wildfires, practice agroforestry where possible, and maintain natural buffers to preserve biodiversity.

questions.question: How do you manage water and waste?
questions.answer: Our farm relies on natural rainfall, and we avoid chemical runoff. As we expand, we will develop water-efficient systems and composting solutions to maintain soil health and reduce waste.

questions.question: What is your approach to ESG?
questions.answer: AfriNuts is committed to Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) principles. This includes reinvesting in local infrastructure, promoting inclusive hiring, and ensuring transparent governance aligned with ethical values.

questions.question: How is the farm aligned with Islamic investment principles?
questions.answer: We operate under a no-riba (no interest) policy and prioritize partnerships that reflect shared risk and profit. Our investor model is based on ethical financing, community benefit, and long-term sustainability.

questions.question: Is there interest (riba) involved in your funding model?
questions.answer: No. We do not charge or pay interest. Our investors receive a share of the net profit (e.g., 25%) based on performance, not fixed returns. This aligns with Islamic financial ethics.

questions.question: How do you reinvest profits into the community?
questions.answer: We reinvest 10% of our net profits into local community initiatives. Examples include: drilling water wells, supporting local madrasas (Islamic schools), and contributing to mosque maintenance. This is our commitment to sadaqah jariyah — ongoing charity that benefits generations.

questions.question: When will the processing center be operational?
questions.answer: The cashew processing center is planned for construction starting in 2028, pending land title finalization and investment. Our target is operations by 2031. We will share updates as milestones are reached.

visualAid.caption: Rendering of our future processing facility

questions.question: What makes your center eco-friendly?
questions.answer: Our center will integrate solar power, water-efficient systems, and ethical labor practices. We aim to build a model agro-industrial site that minimizes carbon emissions and supports the circular economy.

questions.question: Will it serve the local community?
questions.answer: Yes. Beyond cashew processing, the center will provide employment, skill training, and community development. It is part of our broader vision to establish Odienné as a hub for ethical agriculture.

questions.question: How do you ensure the quality of your cashews?
questions.answer: Quality control starts in the field. Our Farm OS tracks moisture content, nut count, and defect rates per batch. When you receive a shipment, you receive the data — not just the nuts.

questions.question: Are your products traceable?
questions.answer: Yes — and we mean that differently than most suppliers. Our Farm OS provides block-level traceability: GPS coordinates, harvest date, processing batch, and quality metrics. Enter your batch ID on our Trace page and see the full journey yourself. No login required.

questions.question: What logistics options do you offer?
questions.answer: We ship from the Port of Abidjan — one of West Africa's most efficient deep-water ports. Current lead times: 4-6 weeks to Europe, 6-8 weeks to North America, 3-4 weeks to Middle East. Every shipment includes Farm OS traceability documentation.

questions.question: Do you offer bulk pricing?
questions.answer: Yes, we offer tiered pricing based on order volume. Please contact our sales team for detailed pricing information.

questions.question: What certifications do you have?
questions.answer: We are pursuing organic certification, ISO 22000 for food safety, and other relevant certifications for international export. Documentation is available upon request.

questions.question: What logistics options do you offer?
questions.answer: We ship from the Port of Abidjan, one of West Africa's most efficient ports. Current lead times: 4-6 weeks to Europe, 6-8 weeks to North America, 3-4 weeks to Middle East. We offer FOB Abidjan and can arrange CIF for qualified buyers. Custom logistics solutions available for large volumes.

questions.question: Can I invest in AfriNuts Export?
questions.answer: Yes. We welcome ethical investors aligned with our mission. Our investor dashboard provides real-time visibility into farm performance — trees alive, expenses per block, revenue by quality grade. This is the same data we use to run the business. Start by downloading our NDA on the Invest page.

questions.question: What is the expected return on investment?
questions.answer: Returns are based on profit-sharing, not fixed interest. Investors receive a share of net profits, with projections available on request. Returns depend on farm performance and market conditions.

questions.question: What are the contract terms?
questions.answer: Our investment contracts are structured with 5-year terms, with options for renewal. All contracts include transparent reporting and governance provisions.

questions.question: Do you provide sustainability audits?
questions.answer: Yes. Our Farm OS tracks environmental metrics alongside production data — water usage, organic inputs, waste diversion. We provide summary reports to investors with data pulled directly from our operating system, not estimates.

questions.question: How can I become a partner?
questions.answer: We welcome partnerships with distributors, retailers, and complementary businesses. Please contact our partnership team to discuss opportunities.

questions.question: Do you offer white-label options?
questions.answer: Yes, we offer white-label packaging and private label options for qualified partners with sufficient order volumes.

questions.question: What support do you provide to partners?
questions.answer: We provide marketing materials, product training, and joint promotional opportunities to our partners to ensure mutual success.

questions.question: What partnership models do you offer?
questions.answer: We offer four models: (1) Outgrower Cooperative — expand our farmer network, (2) White-Label/Co-Packing — we process under your brand, (3) Farm OS Licensing — deploy our platform on your farm, (4) Joint Venture Processing — build processing centers together. Visit our Partners page for details.

questions.question: Is Farm OS available for licensing?
questions.answer: Yes. We offer Farm OS licensing for large-scale farms, agribusinesses, and government programs. The platform is crop-agnostic — currently built for cashew but adaptable to cocoa, shea, coffee, and other crops. Contact us to discuss deployment.

questions.question: Can I visit the farm before partnering?
questions.answer: Absolutely. We encourage serious partners to visit our 35-hectare farm in Odienné and see Farm OS in action. There is no substitute for seeing the operation firsthand. Visits are arranged on request.

questions.question: Do you offer white-label or private label options?
questions.answer: Yes. We offer white-label processing and packaging for qualified partners with sufficient volume. Your brand, our Farm OS traceability, and our certified supply chain.

questions.question: What is the minimum commitment for a partnership?
questions.answer: We design pilot projects with small scope and clear metrics before scaling. Minimum volumes depend on the partnership model. Contact our partnership team to discuss your specific needs.

questions.question: Who leads AfriNuts Export?
questions.answer: AfriNuts is led by Hamza Sangare (CEO) — a software engineer who built Farm OS himself — alongside a team with expertise in finance, agriculture, technology, and community development. Our founder's dual background in tech and farming is what makes our operating model possible.

questions.question: How is governance handled?
questions.answer: Our governance is transparent and participatory, with oversight from both local stakeholders and external advisors to ensure accountability.

questions.question: How is the project financed?
questions.answer: The project is financed through a mix of equity investment, ethical financing, and reinvested profits. We avoid debt with interest (riba) to align with our values.

questions.question: Do you offer financial reports?
questions.answer: Yes. We provide regular financial updates and transparent reporting to all stakeholders and investors.
